Attached: 1 video

JustRead 5.6 can follow along with your own audiobook.

Download the EPUB and the audiobook from Audiobookshelf or your own files and link them. The iPhone listens to the recording once to find each sentence ( about 3 minutes for a 3h 39m book). Then the page follows the narrator.

Free for 14 days, then $4.99/month, $29.99/year or $79.99 once.
